snippet.title: Playstation : Spectral Tower ΙΙ (JPN)
snippet.description:
Spectral Tower ΙΙ (スペクトラルタワーII) is an RPG that developed and published by Idea Factory back in 1998, exclusively for the Sony Playstation home console system and the Japanese market.

An enormous tower stretched high up into the sky, said to contain Infinite Power and Eternal Life within its walls. One young traveler from a faraway land pressed forth on his journey to the tower. Little did he know this journey would have a profound effect on the fate of the world.

ST2 is a fairly basic RPG with turn based battles. All of the fights begin only when you come in contact with your enemies.
Unlike the previous game, most of it's graphics are pre-rendered , the sound quality more clear and the heroes are designed with more details.
Ιn manners of duration, Spectral Tower 2 is not a huge game but it can last up to 20 hours if you are willing to explore "completely" each one of it's 3 tower parts. 

It's not an import friendly game.
